text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Christmas had arrived. Caught up in the 
cheerful music playing throughout the 
town, I found myself humming along when...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...You're in good spirits.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You don't have to apologize, but...

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, they just restocked that cake over 
there! —Wait, really!? We gotta go buy 
some right now!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, the flow of the crowd shifted. 
The two of us got swept up in the rush of 
people going after the cake...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...H-Hold on...!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly... Where on earth is this? 
Another crowd, too..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right. If we stay here, we'll 
just get dragged into—"

text_block_list.name: Person Dressed as Santa
text_block_list.text:
Ho, ho, ho! Merry Christmas! 
Congratulations on being the 3,000th 
visitor to the Furlong Tower 
Illuminations!

text_block_list.name: Person Dressed as Santa
text_block_list.text:
Here's a present for being a good kid! And 
let's take a commemorative photo with me!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
No, I'll pass... I... had no intention of 
joining.

text_block_list.name: Person Dressed as Santa
text_block_list.text:
You had no intention of entering, yet here 
you are? That itself is a Christmas 
miracle! Come now, let us take a 
commemorative photo together!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a cheerful Christmas song playing in 
the background, the two of us returned to 
the academy in silence...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That night, a Christmas party was held at 
the dormitory where the Umamusume live. 
The lively atmosphere could be felt all 
the way over here, but—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...*inhale*... *phew*.
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to the Christmas party?
Aren't you going to the Christmas party?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ! Were you following me?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...It's fine. I gave my greetings, and I 
ate the meal that was served.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Beyond that, only those who want to get 
hyped need to get hyped.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...It's been on my mind since earlier 
today. She naturally prefers quiet places, 
but today... it feels like she's 
deliberately avoiding people."
choice_data_list: Are you not a fan of Christmas?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm not sure if 'dislike' is the right 
word. I just feel out of place during this 
time of year."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...The illumination lights are far too 
bright. The warmth of happiness burns far 
too hot.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever I'm there... it becomes 
unbearable. No matter how much time 
passes, it never feels like home."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Even from here, the illuminations are 
quite dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You won't be able to see them anymore. The 
stars, from there.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...That's why I come here. A place that 
is quiet, cold, and under the stars."
choice_data_list: ...Has it been like that for a long time?

I think it's fine for everyone to spend 
their time their own way.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...If you're going to pry any deeper, 
please leave.
choice_data_list: Sorry, that was so insensitive of me...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After that, she fell completely silent. 
Christmas doesn't always symbolize 
happiness. That truth was driven home to 
me that night."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...That's true.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
So please, just go back. You should spend 
your time having fun with everyone else...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her quiet words were swallowed up by the 
starry sky. In a world cut off from the 
warmth of the earth below, she gazed up at 
the stars alone.
